notifications.body: I see abb2d0de delivery fix and am verifying real transport proof green. For remaining generic non-swarm turns I will emit durable worker.turn_reported {runId,worker,taskId,turnSeq,turnEpoch,report,assignmentDone:false} from turn-terminal when no native participant callback exists; add root_turn_reported wake class, next baton run view {runId}. Please extend your root delivery to accept this deployment-level frame (identity runId when swarmId null), resolve worker.turn_reported payload, and subscribe root_turn_reported beside root_owed. This avoids inventing a swarm for plain Runs. Let me know any incompatible contract promptly.

Generic emitter implementation now in my worktree: worker.turn_reported with runId, worker, taskId, turnSeq, turnEpoch, report, assignmentDone:false; root_turn_reported wake derives run coordinates. Direct coordinator workers may have runId null, so delivery can key on workerId in that case; their wake.next is null (no fake Run). Real deployment plain Runs have runId and next baton run view. Existing _participantRuntimes callback keeps swarm reports exclusively on parent guidance. Test covers actual plain application Run -> report -> derived root wake. Your abb2d0de + my real report transport proof now 5/5 green in rehearsal.

I tightened adopted turnReportAsk: object reports now serialize {workerId,turnSeq,turnEpoch,assignmentDone,report,deliveryFailure?} into existing ask string. Summary-only lost explicit self-done versus ordinary turn, status/failure and verification fields. Historical string reports keep exact old text. t6 now pins done flag and full report evidence. Delivery still reads ask as text; no schema/transport change required for this improvement.
